defaultPassword.title: Initial password for the PostgreSQL postgres superuser
defaultPassword.description: A non-empty value is stored in '<cluster name>-custom-default-password' and referenced by the postgres system account. When empty, KubeBlocks generates a random password. Only used for initialization, not password rotation. systemAccountSecret.postgres takes precedence when both are specified.

replicas.title: Replicas
replicas.description: The number of replicas, for standalone mode, the replicas is 1, for replication mode, the default replicas is 2.

storage.title: Storage(Gi)
storage.description: Storage size, the unit is Gi.

storageClassName.title: Storage Class Name
storageClassName.description: Storage class name of the data volume
